# BlenderKit

> > BlenderKit is a 3D asset library and add-on for Blender, providing materials, models, HDRs, and node groups with integrated asset validation and creator tools.

BlenderKit serves both creators and users in the Blender 3D ecosystem, offering documentation on asset uploads, validation requirements, and troubleshooting. The platform uses Django/Python backend infrastructure and provides GDPR-compliant services for 3D asset management and distribution.

## Key Topics

- Blender 3D modeling and materials
- Asset upload validation and requirements
- UV mapping and material setup
- 3D printable models (FDM and resin)
- HDR environment maps
- Mesh quality and normals
- Thumbnail generation
- Creator payouts and licensing
- Python and Django backend
- Asset troubleshooting
- Node groups and materials
- Scene lighting techniques
- GDPR data protection
- Release notes and updates

## Upload Troubleshooting & Asset Validation

- [Don't include UV maps names in the material](https://www.blenderkit.com/docs/tutorials/most-common-upload-problems/uv-maps-material): Tutorial on avoiding UV map names in materials for BlenderKit uploads
- [Inverted normals](https://www.blenderkit.com/docs/tutorials/most-common-upload-problems/fixing-inverted-normals-in-blender): Tutorial on fixing inverted normals in Blender mesh editing
- [Insufficient lighting](https://www.blenderkit.com/docs/tutorials/most-common-upload-problems/unsufficient-scene-lighting): Guide on proper 3D scene lighting for BlenderKit asset uploads
- [Upload real HDRs](https://www.blenderkit.com/docs/tutorials/most-common-upload-problems/low-range-for-hdr): HDR upload requirements: bit depth and 360-degree image guidelines
- [Not printable](https://www.blenderkit.com/docs/tutorials/most-common-upload-problems/not-printable): Guide on 3D printable model requirements for FDM and resin printers

## Creator Support & FAQ

- [Creators FAQ](https://www.blenderkit.com/docs/faq-creators): FAQ covering payouts, licensing, uploads, and earnings for creators
